name: training_curves
description: Training/validation loss and metric curves over epochs

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import json, os

# Load style
with open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', 'style_config.json')) as f:
    style = json.load(f)

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': style['font_family'],
    'font.size': style['font_size']['label'],
    'axes.labelsize': style['font_size']['label'],
    'xtick.labelsize': style['font_size']['tick'],
    'ytick.labelsize': style['font_size']['tick'],
    'legend.fontsize': style['font_size']['legend'],
    'lines.linewidth': style['line_width'],
    'lines.markersize': style['marker_size'],
    'figure.dpi': style['dpi'],
    'savefig.dpi': style['dpi'],
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

# === Load data ===

# epochs = df['epoch'].values

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(style['fig_width']['single'],
                                    style['fig_width']['single'] * style['fig_height_ratio']))

# === Plot loss curves ===

ax1.legend(loc='upper right')

# === Save ===
output_dir = os.environ.get('PAPER_FIGURES_OUTPUT_DIR', os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', 'export'))
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
base = os.path.join(output_dir, 'training_curves')
fig.savefig(f'{base}.pdf', format='pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{base}.svg', format='svg')
